claims.claim: Will start his 300th Grand Prix at home; on 28 Oct 2026 extended Cadillac contract to at least end of 2029
claims.note: Eurosport: 'jusqu'en 2029', 300e Grand Prix this weekend, updated 28/10/2026; Sky: stay at Cadillac until at least the end of 2029, announced Wednesday.

claims.claim: Race on Sunday 1 November at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez
claims.note: F1 race page: 'Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez', schedule '01Nov Race 20:00'.

claims.claim: Previous Cadillac deal understood to end 2027; new deal adds two years
claims.note: Sky: original contract 'understood to have been due to expire at the end of 2027'.

claims.claim: Age 36 at the announcement
claims.note: Eurosport: 'Pérez, 36 ans'. Consistent with birth date 26 Jan 1990.

claims.claim: Karting from age six
claims.note: El Financiero: 'a los seis años ya formaba parte del karting'.

claims.claim: 2004 Skip Barber National Championship
claims.note: El Financiero: 'En 2004 participó en el Campeonato Nacional Skip Barber'.

claims.claim: Moved to Europe at 14; joined BMW in Germany in 2005
claims.note: El Financiero: 'A los 14 años se mudó a Europa'; 'integrarse a la BMW en Alemania en 2005'.

claims.claim: Good Formula 3 results with T-Sport; 2009 British GP2 Series
claims.note: El Financiero: 'buenos resultados en la Fórmula 3 con el equipo T-Sport'; 'el campeonato británico de la GP2 Series en 2009'.

claims.claim: Born Guadalajara 26 January 1990
claims.note: F1 profile 26/01/1990, Guadalajara; Wikidata 26 January 1990, Guadalajara.

claims.claim: Entered F1 in 2011 as Ferrari Academy driver at Sauber; stayed for 2012; McLaren 2013 as Hamilton replacement; Force India/Racing Point 2014-2020
claims.note: The Race: 'entered F1 in 2011 as a Ferrari Academy driver placed at Sauber'; 'Still on the Ferrari Academy for 2012, he stayed with Sauber'; McLaren 2013 replacing Hamilton; 'seven years at Force India/Racing Point from 2014-20'.

claims.claim: First win at 2020 Sakhir GP in pink Racing Point Mercedes
claims.note: RacingNews365: 'first F1 win at the Sakhir Grand Prix after a sensational drive from the back of the grid'; The Race: 'pink Mercedes' for Racing Point.

claims.claim: Joined Red Bull in 2021
claims.note: Al Jazeera: 'joined Red Bull in 2021'.

claims.claim: Went to Red Bull believing he could compete with Verstappen; first Red Bull win at Baku 2021
claims.note: The Race: joined 'in the belief that he would be able to compete with Verstappen'; 'happy hunting ground of Baku he scored his first victory for the team'. RacingNews365: 2021 Azerbaijan first Red Bull win.

claims.claim: Six GP wins, 39 podiums, 1,638 career points
claims.note: F1 profile: Highest Race Finish 1 (x6), Podiums 39, Career Points 1638.

claims.claim: Five Red Bull wins: Baku 2021, Monaco and Singapore 2022, Saudi Arabia and Azerbaijan 2023
claims.note: RacingNews365 lists these wins with the Red Bull years.

claims.claim: Singapore win probably best of his career; Jeddah 2023 was the win denied in 2022
claims.note: The Race: 'probably the best win of his career' (Singapore); 'he took the Jeddah victory he was denied in 2022'.

claims.claim: Runner-up in the 2023 drivers' championship
claims.note: The Race: 'finished runner-up in the 2023 drivers' world championship'.

claims.claim: Horner quote on two Constructors' titles and first 1-2
claims.note: Al Jazeera quotes Horner: 'helping us to two Constructors' titles and to our first 1-2 finish in the Drivers' championship'.

claims.claim: Left Red Bull after four seasons; eighth in 2024 drivers' standings; Red Bull third in constructors'
claims.note: Al Jazeera: 'after four seasons'; 'came eighth in the drivers' standings'; Red Bull 'surrendered their team title to McLaren with a third-place finish'.

claims.claim: Pérez farewell quote
claims.note: Quote matches Al Jazeera text exactly.

claims.claim: Year out in 2025 after being dropped by Red Bull, return with Cadillac in 2026
claims.note: Sky: 'had a year on the sidelines' after being dropped by Red Bull at end of 2024; RacingNews365: 'After a year on the sidelines, he returns to F1 with the new Cadillac team'.

claims.claim: 18 Grand Prix starts for Cadillac in 2026, no points, five retirements, no top-10 finish, six sprints without points
claims.note: F1 profile 2026: Grand Prix Races 18, Grand Prix Points 0, DNFs 5, Grand Prix Top 10s 0, Sprint Races 6, Sprint Points 0.

claims.claim: Barcelona June 2026: started 19th, finished 14th, best Cadillac result, no points yet
claims.note: Record (14 June 2026): started 19th, 'terminó en la P14'; 'mejor resultado para Checo con Cadillac en esta primera temporada'; 'no ha sumado puntos'.

claims.claim: Sky: last in drivers' championship but ahead of Bottas
claims.note: Sky: 'he is last in the Drivers' Championship'; outperformed Bottas per Sky.

claims.claim: 300th start in Mexico City; called it a very important moment in his career
claims.note: Cronica quotes Pérez: 'Alcanzar los 300 Grandes Premios es un momento muy importante en mi carrera'.

claims.claim: Public show on Paseo de la Reforma Wednesday 28 October from 10:00, organised by Cadillac F1 Team and GP de Mexico
claims.note: Cronica: 'miércoles 28 de octubre, a partir de las 10:00 am'; 'organizado por Cadillac Formula 1 Team y el GP de México'.

claims.claim: The Race: electrified F1's following in Mexico
claims.note: The Race: 'electrified F1's following in his home country of Mexico'.

claims.claim: Sky: will celebrate 300th start this Sunday
claims.note: Sky: 'will celebrate his 300th grand prix start this Sunday'.

claims.claim: 299 Grand Prix entries before Mexico City
claims.note: F1 profile: Grands Prix Entered 299.
